legacy.full_text: Incredible showcase of what is possible in 3D using flutter_scene, Antigravity, and Gemini 4!

profile_bio.description:
Building Flutter GPU and https://t.co/uRtNaXlmwa. Expanding what you can create using Flutter & Dart.

Prev Lead Eng @shorebirddev
Prev Built Impeller @flutterdev / @google

result.text:
Gemini 4 Argon + @FlutterDev is cracked.

@antigravity built this car infotainment screen and driver cluster with Flutter Scene in a day. It's all one Flutter app. :)

The map uses real OpenStreetMap buildings in downtown Boston and a live route from OSRM. The x-ray chassis uses a custom material, and the brake discs glow as the car brakes. The car is a glTF model with working doors, hood, hatch, headlights, and paint options. The parking screen is a mockup of a 360 surround camera view.

No embedded engine, no native map SDK, no platform views, just vanilla Flutter with Impeller and built-in SDK features: Flutter GPU. 3D rendered by Flutter Scene, a complete 3D game engine for Flutter.

The app is 14,000 lines of Dart, with a center screen, a driver cluster, and a panoramic view of both.

No subscriptions, no paid seats, no royalties. Free and open source, forever. Flutter can just do it all.

result.text:
Meet Google AI Edge Foresight, our newest Labs app (https://t.co/IyRiJWZd7W), offering an ambient note-taking meeting companion and personal knowledge assistant for Mac. Your audio, transcripts and sensitive files in your personal knowledge base never leave your device courtesy of local processing with EmbeddingGemma2 & Gemma4 suite of models.

- Live Notes Enhancement: Jot down quick shorthand notes during a meeting and Foresight enriches it in real time using the live meeting conversation. 

- Ambient Audio Query Detection: Detects questions spoken aloud mid-meeting and surfaces answers live. 

- Blazing-Fast Grounded Responses: Point it at your local project folders, docs, transcripts or Drive account for instant cross-modal retrieval and Q&A.
